commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' 3 - 2 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Urko Gonzalez and Pere Milla (Espanyol) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 3:2.
90+8' The linesman makes the right call and Espanyol will have a corner.
90+7' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Espanyol.
90+2' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Espanyol players look gutted.
90+2' The Espanyol players halt their celebrations as referee Javier Alberola makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
89' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) replacing Munir El Haddadi.
89' Espanyol take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
89' Substitution. Diego Garcia did his best and is replaced by Duk (Leganes).
86' A pass into the penalty area from Diego Garcia (Leganes) is intercepted by the defence.
80' Substitution. Yvan Neyou leaves the pitch and is replaced by Darko Brasanac (Leganes).
79' 3 - 1 Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom left corner, and thus alter the score to 3:1.
79' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
79' The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.
77' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Espanyol.
76' The corner is swung in but Espanyol can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
75' 9:16 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
75' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
74' A substitution has been made. Dani Raba is replaced by Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes).
73' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
72' Manolo Gonzalez prepares a substitution. Javi Puado is replaced by Walid Cheddira (Espanyol).
72' It is time for a substitution. Pere Milla (Espanyol) is on for Roberto Fernandez Jaen.
72' Javier Alberola interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adria Altimira (Leganes).
69' Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
69' Total attempts – 13:4.
63' 3 - 0 OWN GOAL! The free kick is whipped in and the ball hits Marash Kumbulla (Espanyol), who finds the back of his own net. 3:0.
63' There is a free kick near the sideline to Leganes.
62' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to make a change. Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) replaces Jofre.
61' Dani Raba (Leganes) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
61' Joan Garcia (Espanyol) might have got lucky there after the VAR review resulted in referee Javier Alberola deciding not to issue any card.
60' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Joan Garcia (Espanyol)! Let's see what he decides.
59' Dani Raba (Leganes) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
57' Joan Garcia (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Javier Alberola and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
54' Carlos Romero beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Alejo Veliz (Espanyol), who smashes a first-time shot well wide of the left post.
48' Dani Raba (Leganes) will take the free kick.

48' A cross from the side line is well received by Renato Tapia (Leganes) who doesn't hesitate to slam it goalwards. And his long-range effort wasn't poor at all. It attracted the keeper's attention as it missed the left post only by a whisker.
47' Dangerous play by Carlos Romero (Espanyol). Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Dani Raba (Leganes) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

46' Yan Diomande (Leganes) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Leganes.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Fernando Calero comes off for Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manolo Gonzalez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Alex Kral. He is replaced by Alejo Veliz (Espanyol).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' Although Javi Puado (Espanyol) is just on the bench, Javier Alberola has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

45+4' Exposito (Espanyol) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45+3' Yan Diomande (Leganes) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
45+1' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
45+1' Exposito (Espanyol) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jofre (Espanyol) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Urko Gonzalez (Espanyol) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

41' 2 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Dani Raba, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Yan Diomande (Leganes), who beats Joan Garcia with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
37' Dani Raba (Leganes) will take the corner.
37' Dani Raba (Leganes) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted. Leganes will take a corner kick.
37' The ball is out of play and Leganes manage to earn a corner.
36' Renato Tapia (Leganes) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

33' 1 - 0 Goal! Dani Raba displays great vision and sends a pass to Seydouba Cisse (Leganes), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
32' Diego Garcia (Leganes) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and balloons his close-range header high over the bar.
32' Leganes are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
32' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
32' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
30' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
30' The Espanyol players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
28' Yan Diomande (Leganes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
24' Dani Raba (Leganes) is penalised for a foul. Javier Alberola had a clear view and blows his whistle.
23' Yan Diomande links up with Seydouba Cisse (Leganes), who fires just wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
22' Javi Puado (Espanyol) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Jofre (Espanyol) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
20' A corner kick by Espanyol is thwarted by the well prepared Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes).
19' The free kick from long range, taken by Espanyol, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Espanyol.
19' Yan Diomande (Leganes) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
16' Alex Kral (Espanyol) sends an accurate short pass. Jofre controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
16' Yan Diomande (Leganes) shows his incredible technical ability by sending the ball into free space and Diego Garcia latches onto his pass.
11' Celebrations are cut short for Leganes as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
9' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Javier Alberola is going to take a look using VAR.
9' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
9' Yan Diomande (Leganes) takes a direct free kick.
8' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
5' Adria Altimira (Leganes) sends a cross into the box, but Joan Garcia comes off his line to gather the ball.

4' This was a piece of cake for Joan Garcia. Diego Garcia (Leganes) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went towards the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
3' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Leganes.
2' Dani Raba (Leganes) collects a pass on the edge of the box but he slips the ball just wide of the right post.
2' Javi Puado (Espanyol) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola.
Show lineups Both teams starting lineups are available now, so you can have a look at them.
